itens.trecho: American Horror Story é uma das minhas séries favoritas e aquela que acompanho há mais anos. Tinha 15 ou 16 anos quando a primeira temporada estreou e fiquei completamente fascinado, pois pegou nos filmes de terror que costumava ver e levou-os para o formato de série, com histórias mais complexas, personagens marcantes e reviravoltas imprevisíveis, que me…

Thoughts on Apocalypse In our new age of terrifying, lethal gadgets, which supplanted so swiftly the old one, the first great aggressive war, if it should come, will be launched by suicidal little madmen pressing an electronic button. Such a war will not last long and none will ever follow it.

Thoughts on 1984 They Live was a primal scream against Reaganism of the '80s. And the '80s never went away. They're still with us. That's what makes They Live look so fresh – it's a document of greed and insanity. It's about life in the United States then and now. If anything, things have gotten worse.
